verdicts.title: Task / Execution Identity Audit
verdicts.decision: Keep task authority, native session/execution identity, and event stream identity separate.

verdicts.title: Event Semantics Crosswalk
verdicts.decision: Keep bounded event projection; pending/terminal remain authoritative current state independent of event history.

verdicts.title: Claude permission pending-set transition projection
verdicts.original_problem: Permission timeout/disconnect could remove the broker request without refreshing RuntimeStore pending_requests.

verdicts.title: Serializable durable HITL pause/resume
verdicts.decision: Do not build durability into Bridges; evaluate a durable runtime only if REF-03C hard triggers become real.

verdicts.title: Native Harness Ownership
verdicts.decision: Codex, Pi and Claude Code remain owners of model/tool agent loops.

verdicts.title: Cancellation / Lifecycle / Hook Crosswalk
verdicts.decision: Keep thin native cancellation mapping and event projection; do not add a generic Bridge hook system.

verdicts.title: Double-Harness Duplication Audit
verdicts.decision: No second model/tool loop, generic tool registry, transcript DB, retry engine, or Bridge router exists.

verdicts.title: Worker-neutral Runtime Capability Matrix
verdicts.decision: A shared workflow runtime is not a current requirement.

verdicts.title: P2/P3 Runtime-creep Audit
verdicts.decision: P2/P3 remain pure Supervisor policies and do not own durable execution.

verdicts.title: Durable-runtime Admission Criteria
verdicts.decision: Adoption deferred until a hard durability trigger is demonstrated.
